India braces for intensified monsoon with heavy rain warnings

India is experiencing an intensification of its monsoon season, with forecasts predicting heavy to very heavy rainfall across several regions. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued warnings for thunderstorms, gusty winds, and lightning in various parts of the country. This increased rainfall activity is occurring as the southwest monsoon remains active, with some reports noting a slow advance of the monsoon.
